Every oversight body in Canada — Ethics Commissioner, RCMP, MPCC, Procurement Ombudsman, NSIRA, CEIPP — can investigate, review, report, and recommend. None can enforce. The architecture produces accountability theatre: the appearance of oversight without the substance of consequence. This is not a failure of individual institutions. It is how the system is designed.
